row.title: Ashby's journal runs in the kernel
row.body: ASHBY-KERNEL-1: the kernel goal loop vetoes a step that upsets a holding variable (confirm or exonerate by reading the undo), searches past a knob's declared direction to the nearest untried value, reads requisite variety from the work queue and reducibility from goals and knobs. 41 concepts in doctrine/ashby-concepts.json cite journal pages; 4 are gaps on Q-ASHBY items. The archive's text is not copied: own wording, page numbers, links.
